about: What can be done with this model: moving parts, slots for loose items, emitters (lights, sounds, switches) and traits. Same fields as art/data/interactions.json, in Blender space (X right, Y back, Z up, front is -Y), metres; the GLB itself is glTF space (x, z, -y). Written by tools/make_manifest.py; see art/scripts/emitters.py for the fields.
